root_cause.text: Use-after-free in xfrm_policy_bysel_ctx() due to accessing an inexact bin after releasing xfrm_policy_lock, allowing a concurrent xfrm_hash_rebuild() to free the bin via kfree_rcu() before pruning.
root_cause.evidence: The race description in the commit message shows CPU0 releases the lock, CPU1 frees the bin (kfree_rcu) during xfrm_hash_rebuild, then CPU0 calls xfrm_policy_inexact_prune_bin(bin) on the freed bin. The patch moves the __xfrm_policy_inexact_prune_bin() call inside the locked region to prevent the race.
